given_when_then.given: A payment is processed between a customer and a store partner
given_when_then.when: The system generates a financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: The record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.

given_when_then.given: A delivery proof is missing for a completed order
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to archive the financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: The system must flag the record as incomplete and prevent final settlement until delivery proof is provided.

given_when_then.given: A store partner agreement is available
given_when_then.when: The system generates a financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: Contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules must be archived alongside the financial transaction record.

given_when_then.given: A deviation from the standard financial transaction process occurs
given_when_then.then: The nature of the issue and the current resolution status must be recorded.

success_criteria: A financial transaction record is generated with all required cost components: item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts.
A financial transaction record is flagged as incomplete when delivery proof is missing for a completed order.
Final settlement is prevented for a financial transaction record when delivery proof is unavailable.
Contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules are archived alongside the financial transaction record.
